brief.text: Closed-End Funds feature heavily in the cluster data, with BPRE, NXG, and CRAFX drawing multiple buyers for a combined total exceeding $43.4 million. BORR recorded the largest single cluster total at $57,144,458 across three insiders, far outpacing every other ticker, while FUL stands out for breadth with an unusual eight separate insiders purchasing a total of $1,123,318. In notable individual purchases, a 10% owner accounted for the largest trade with $6,259,186 in CRBG, accompanied by a $1,108,000 purchase from the CEO at DINO.
